title: Ban cap nhat v1.9.5 - Khac phuc triet de loi man hinh den va ket noi View Scrcpy ngay khi mo app
releaseNotes:
- Khac phuc triet de loi man hinh den (Black screen) khi moi mo app: Nap danh sach thiet bi ngay lap tuc khi app khoi dong giup View ket noi tuc thi
- Loai bo timeout 5 giay gay kill nham tien trinh Scrcpy dang truyen hinh anh
- AutoHeal Watchdog khong con can thiep kill nham khi tien trinh scrcpy dang hoat dong binh thuong
- Giu nguyen ket noi Scrcpy on dinh tren moi phien ban Android tu 10 den 14
